```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/moran_local_2021_waste.csv')
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Drop missing value borough
df_clean = df.dropna().copy()
boroughs = df_clean['borough'].tolist()
print("Boroughs after dropping missing:", len(boroughs))
print("Dropped:", df[df['Waste_value'].isnull()]['borough'].values[0])

# Build symmetric adjacency excluding the dropped borough
neighbor_dict = {b: set() for b in boroughs}
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    n = row['neighbor']
    if b in neighbor_dict and n in neighbor_dict:
        neighbor_dict[b].add(n)
        neighbor_dict[n].add(b)

# Check neighbors of dropped borough from original data
dropped = df[df['Waste_value'].isnull()]['borough'].values[0]
dropped_neighbors = set()
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    if row['borough'] == dropped and row['neighbor'] in neighbor_dict:
        dropped_neighbors.add(row['neighbor'])
    if row['neighbor'] == dropped and row['borough'] in neighbor_dict:
        dropped_neighbors.add(row['borough'])
print(f"\nNeighbors of {dropped}: {dropped_neighbors}")

# Verify all remaining boroughs have at least one neighbor
for b in boroughs:
    if len(neighbor_dict[b]) == 0:
        print(f"WARNING: {b} has no neighbors!")

# Compute statistics
values = df_clean['Waste_value'].values
mean_val = np.mean(values)
std_val = np.std(values, ddof=1)
z_scores = (values - mean_val) / std_val

print(f"\nMean waste: {mean_val:.4f}")
print(f"Std waste: {std_val:.4f}")
print(f"Z-score range: [{z_scores.min():.4f}, {z_scores.max():.4f}]")

# Compute observed Local Moran's I
observed_I = {}
for i, b in enumerate(boroughs):
    neighbors = list(neighbor_dict[b])
    if len(neighbors) == 0:
        observed_I[b] = np.nan
        continue
    neighbor_zs = [z_scores[boroughs.index(n)] for n in neighbors]
    avg_neighbor_z = np.mean(neighbor_zs)
    observed_I[b] = z_scores[i] * avg_neighbor_z

print("\nObserved Local Moran's I values:")
for b, val in sorted(observed_I.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
    print(f"  {b}: {val:.4f} (z={z_scores[boroughs.index(b)]:.4f}, n_neighbors={len(neighbor_dict[b])})")
```
